notes.title: Patch #1 and Deluxe Edition is here!
notes.content:
[h3]Patch #1[/h3][p]We understand there are a wide range of gamers looking for different experiences from the game, from long time fans and Shoot 'em up players to those preferring a less frantic flight to Colossatropolis, so we have good news for you! 

Our first patch includes:
- All new Easy difficulty, making a total of 5 difficulty levels[/p][p]- Previous difficulties moved up one rank[/p][p]- Easy and Regular modes have several stress-reducing quality of life improvements[/p][p]- Difficulty descriptions to help you choose your game style[/p][p]- Various bug fixes[/p][p]We’re already working on the next patch which focuses on Steam Workshop and built-in music customisation support. Free additional content is in the works too![/p][p][/p][h3]Platypus Reclayed Deluxe edition is available now![/h3][p]The best way to enjoy the Game, Music and Art of Platypus Reclayed. A treat for all Platypus fans and those interested in the games music and unique production. [/p][p][/p][h3]The Original Sound Track (OST)[/h3][p]Includes all the music from the game (so far…) - 15 tracks in total - featuring selections from legendary remix albums of classic Commodore 64 chiptunes including the “Back in Time” series and Karma 64, iconic tracks such as “Wizball 2000”, “Comic Bakery” and "Sanxion" makes this soundtrack legendary on its own.[/p][p][/p][h3]The Art book[/h3][p]Featuring a look at the game’s unique creation process. Learn about how the game's production pipeline has changed over the years from Anthony Flack, accompanied by photographs from the studio and beautiful high resolution images of game models, and plenty more besides.


[b]Patch #1[/b] [b]Changelist[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new difficulty "Easy" with more forgiving level setup and enemy behaviour. Additionally players regain pods whenever they lose a life[/p][/*][*][p]All existing difficulties moved up one difficulty level[/p][/*][*][p]Added difficulty selection description to the UI[/p][/*][*][p]Added extra invulnerability states to "Easy" and "Regular" difficulties so you're briefly protected after collecting a power-up and adjusted invulnerability timings[/p][/*][*][p]Regular difficulty icon features a smile :)[/p][/*][*][p]Ship stat adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]Player homing missiles now move faster (more changes under discussion)[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy homing missiles now move slower, on lower difficulties[/p][/*][*][p]Crates containing weapon pods will deliver a weapon pod if you only have 1 rather than an extra life[/p][/*][*][p]Beginner ship is default on first-time start-up[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced player hitbox size[/p][/*][*][p]Minor level tweaks including to passive resistance[/p][/*][*][p]Boss tweaks[/p][/*][*][p]Super Gunship and Thruster Ship explosions increased [/p][/*][*][p]Lowered opening splash video volume[/p][/*][*][p]Modding: Data changes (mods will need to be updated - see modding docs)[/p][/*][*][p]Modding: Font added to mod pack[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for Ship UI in Score Attack[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for Score saving bug fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for various localisation issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for restarting Score Attack using left mouse button[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for languages using a capital 'i' that is not an 'I'[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for player crash score missing on Score Attack[/p][/*][*][p]Fix with with certain achievements not being awarded in 2 player[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for unlock all giving certain achievements [/p][/*][*][p]Fix for Steam cloud saves[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for Steam achievement status reports[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for Boss 5 death[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for bonus score issue when score is 0[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for invincibility on spawn[/p][/*][*][p]Colossatropolis spelling lessons… again!
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Platypus Reclayed is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Today's the day! Our frantic and fun claymation shoot-em-up is OUT NOW! [/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Play Platypus Reclayed NOW on PC, Mac, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048808/7778440dc11ef9d8f4055408468289b6f9ab41df.png"][/img][/p][p]22 years after its first appearance, led by the original creator [b]Anthony Flack[/b] alongside the Claymatic team, Platypus Reclayed isn't just a simple remaster - [b]it's a complete revamp[/b]: 
[/p][p][b]Reprogrammed from scratch and updated for modern hardware..[/b] [/p][p]Platypus Reclayed is moulded from the ground up with all-new models and artwork photographed in 4k widescreen, featuring updated gameplay, new weapons and additional content. [/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048808/369cdb27ca519a7bf9fb51cfa75957d2d02f3aec.png"][/img][/p][p]This has been a labour of love from all of us at Claymatic - We're happy to finally bring back Platypus after all these years.  🧡 [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Modding | Community-made fun![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048808/2f17c1abd27d7ec8f4e6bd7298aaa1bf6e9c9f99.png"][/img][/p][p][b]We loved the mods and fan art you made for the original game - This time, we've got your back.[/b][/p][p]We've made Platypus Reclayed with the intention of allowing you to create your own custom-made mods - Visit our [url="https://platypus-modding.claymatic.games"][b]Modding Guide[/b][/url]!  📝
[/p][p]To kick things off, Anthony Flack has created a custom level to demonstrate what can be done - Check out [url="https://www.moddb.com/mods/platypus-desert-mission"][b]Platypus Desert Mission[/b][/url].  🏜️  [/p][p][/p][p]Also, if you need assistance with modding, hop in our [url="http://discord.com/invite/claymatic"][b]Discord Server[/b][/url]! 👋[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]We're doing a Giveaway - Win a free copy of the game![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048808/55e92118d02ba4e6e5250693bf8ab3975d0b4723.png"][/img][/p][p]Last but not least.. We're doing a [b]giveaway[/b] over on our socials - Comment on any one of the links below for a chance to win! [/p][list][*][p]🚀  [b][url="https://x.com/ClaymaticGames/status/1968683932230287444"]Twitter[/url][/b][/p][/*][*][p]🚀  [b][url="https://bsky.app/profile/claymatic.games/post/3lz4l3miqf22b"]Bluesky[/url][/b][/p][/*][*][p]🚀  [b][url="https://www.instagram.com/p/DOvzumxElmG/"]Instagram[/url][/b][/p][/*][*][p]🚀  [b][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@claymaticgames/video/7550356273955376389"]TikTok[/url][/b][/p][/*][*][p]🚀  [b][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qHpduaFY1iA"]YouTube[/url]
[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Good luck!  🙌[/p][p][/p][p]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048808/c89e89b6b1463f04132223eeaede03f1a625a301.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]From all of us at Claymatic Games, thank you so much for your support on our journey - We hope you enjoy Platypus Reclayed - Blast Off! 🚀 🧡[/p][p][/p][p][b]Share your Platypus Adventures with us across our socials:[/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/claymatic"][b]Discord[/b][/url][b] [/b]•[b] [url="https://www.youtube.com/@ClaymaticGames"]YouTube[/url] [/b]•[b] [url="https://www.instagram.com/claymaticgames"]Instagram [/url][/b]•[b] [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@claymaticgames?lang=en"]TikTok[/url] [/b]•[b] [url="https://bsky.app/profile/claymatic.games"]Bluesky [/url][/b]•[b] [url="https://twitter.com/ClaymaticGames"]Twitter[/url][/b][/p]

notes.title: Play our updated Platypus Reclayed demo!
notes.content:
[h3]Thanks everyone that played our Steam Next Fest demo back in June! 
[/h3][p]We’ve taken some of your feedback on board and have launched an updated version for you to play in the lead up to launch on September 18th![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048808/b04c449ad65f26941fb18df43e4f2ba5c0c6e0c1.png"][/img][/p][h3]The updated demo features:[/h3][list][*][p]An extra area from level 1[/p][/*][*][p]Improved enemy layout with increased challenge at harder difficulty levels[/p][/*][*][p]Better controller support[/p][/*][*][p]Improved mouse sensitivity[/p][/*][*][p]Ability to turn off the announcer voice[/p][/*][*][p]Updated sound effects[/p][/*][*][p]Updated music tracks to higher quality remixes[/p][/*][*][p]Localisation[/p][/*][*][p]Smoother camera in 2 player[/p][/*][*][p]Many many tweaks, bug fixes and optimisations
[/p][/*][/list][p]The demo has changed to prepare for future modding, if you encounter any bugs please tell us.[/p][p][/p][p][b]We’d love to know what you think. Let us know across our socials:[/b][/p][p][b][url="https://discord.gg/claymatic"]Discord[/url] [/b]•[b] [url="https://www.youtube.com/@ClaymaticGames"]YouTube[/url] [/b]•[b] [url="https://www.instagram.com/claymaticgames"]Instagram [/url][/b]•[b] [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@claymaticgames?lang=en"]TikTok[/url] [/b]•[b] [url="https://bsky.app/profile/claymatic.games"]Bluesky [/url][/b]•[b] [url="https://twitter.com/ClaymaticGames"]Twitter[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048808/c89e89b6b1463f04132223eeaede03f1a625a301.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Platypus Reclayed launches on PC, Mac, PlayStation 4|5, Xbox X|S, and Nintendo Switch on September 18th!  [/p]

notes.title: Platypus Reclayed Launch Date Announcement
notes.content:
[h3]We are proud to reveal Platypus Reclayed is launching September 18th on PC, Mac, PlayStation 4|5, Xbox X|S, and Nintendo Switch! [/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="w34Y8oSRqIY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
We’ve taken everything that was great about the original Platypus game and updated it with a huge host of new features for Platypus Reclayed. [/p][p][/p][h3]Get ready to dive into our fast, frantic, and fun claymation shoot-em-up![/h3][p][/p][p]22 years after its first appearance, led by the original creator Anthony Flack alongside the Claymatic team, Platypus Reclayed isn't just a simple remaster—[b]it's a complete revamp:[/b]
[/p][p]Reprogrammed from scratch and updated for modern hardware, Platypus Reclayed is moulded from the ground up with all-new models and artwork photographed in 4k widescreen, featuring updated gameplay, new weapons and additional content. 

  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048808/369cdb27ca519a7bf9fb51cfa75957d2d02f3aec.png"][/img][/p][h3]Features That Will Keep You Coming Back for More:[/h3][list][*][p]Two-Player Simultaneous Action: Team up with a friend for double the fun![/p][/*][*][p]Stunning Claymation Graphics: Experience the beauty of claymation like never before with all-new high definition artwork.[/p][/*][*][p]Addictive, Exciting Gameplay: Get ready for heart-pounding action that will keep you on the edge of your seat.[/p][/*][*][p]The original Platypus soundtrack is back with even more officially licensed remixes of classic 1980s game tunes from our friends at C64audio.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustable Difficulty Settings: Whether you're a novice or a seasoned pro, Platypus has a challenge for everyone.[/p][/*][*][p]Perfect for the Entire Family: Share the joy of Platypus with loved ones of all ages!
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048808/c89e89b6b1463f04132223eeaede03f1a625a301.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]We hope you are as excited as we are for launch! [/h3][p][/p][p]Let us know across our socials:[/p][p][b][url="https://discord.gg/claymatic"]Discord[/url] [/b]•[b] [url="https://www.youtube.com/@ClaymaticGames"]YouTube[/url] [/b]•[b] [url="https://www.instagram.com/claymaticgames"]Instagram [/url][/b]•[b] [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@claymaticgames?lang=en"]TikTok[/url] [/b]•[b] [url="https://bsky.app/profile/claymatic.games"]Bluesky [/url][/b]•[b] [url="https://twitter.com/ClaymaticGames"]Twitter[/url][/b][/p]
